newsitem.title: UK: BASF SAYS CROP PROTECTION BUY DESIRABLE.
newsitem.headline: BASF SAYS CROP PROTECTION BUY DESIRABLE.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF AG said on Thursday that an acquisition in its crop protection business would be desirable but not necessary to achieve its targets.
"An additional acquisition to complement our product and regional portfolio would be desirable," BASF chairman Juergen Strube said at a news conference here.
"But we do not see this as a prerequisite for achieving our growth targets," he added after BASF earlier reported its first-half results.
Strube said that the goal of launching two new active ingredients within the crop protection business per year was within reach.
"Although no new active substances will be launched in 1998, we expect to introduce five new herbicides and three new fungicides into the market between 1999 and 2002," said Strube.
